167850.overview:
This is a game in which we must fight the gorillas by the hand of Evita and Perón, these characters from Argentina arrive at a time where the country's politics are being highly questioned, discussions are the order of the day for security issues , economy, inflation, the blue dollar, the green, the euros, the countryside, the opposition that fails to put together a plan to deal with the current government, and a lot of issues that we cannot continue to name because space is not enough for us of this entry.
To play we use the keys of the CURSOR KEYBOARD and the MOUSE to shoot and interact.
167850.publisher: Asociación de Desarrolladores de Videojuegos de Argentina

177264.overview:
A game about alienation and refusal of labour.
Music by Jesse Stiles
Made in 6 days for the Experimental Gameplay Project - theme "art game"

181852.overview: Here it is, the sequel to Breaking the Bank! This one's a little different from it's predecessor however. You can actually win! There are three different victorious endings to this game. You can escape the Lame Way, the Sneaky Way, or the Badass Way. See if you can find them all!

201248.overview:
Run away from the bulls or people who are chasing you! How long can you survive? This game was made for Sure Men Deodorant!
You need to keep running and avoid any obstacle along the way. Timing your jump carefully and don't get caught by whoever is chasing you. Clear every stage around the world and have fun!

422854.overview:
Drive your way through a zombie apocalypse!

Earn to Die sees you not only driving your way through hordes of zombies, but allows you to earn cash to upgrade, unlock and customise new vehicles. Is your vehicle not strong enough? Why not add a gun, or boosters, or even a spiked frame?

422907.overview:
Electricman 2 is a simple fighting game where the player controls a stick figure with electric powers. The goal is to defeat several different opponents at a tournament known as The Tournament of Voltagen, each having their own level, where any combination of martial arts, street fighting and superhuman powers are allowed.

You control your character around a flat stage with the left/right arrow keys and down arrow key for a dodge. For attacking, you can use A (punch), S (kick) and D (grab) for regular attacks, and Q (punch), W (kick) and E (grab) for slow motion attacks, which deplete your battery points (though they regenerate automatically), but are significantly more powerful.

422908.overview: Echoes: Act 1 - Operation Stranglehold is the first game in a series of three games planned in total. It is an action-strategy game set in an extensive universe on a torn Earth almost three-hundred years in the future. The game is played as a 2D side-scrolling shooter where the main character is controlled with the cursor keys and aiming is done through the mouse. He can use different weapons such as a futuristic knife and guns, and also has access to abilities to heal or use a shield. The strategy element is introduced through the control over other soldiers as a squad, giving them commands and operating as a group. Throughout the game extensive dialogue is used to further the story and the relationships between the characters.

422909.overview:
pic Battle Fantasy 4 is a light-hearted turn-based RPG, heavily inspired by old classics like Final Fantasy and Golden Sun. You will battle through waves of adorable enemies, grow your characters, explore a diverse world, solve puzzles, and of course, save the world.## Key features

Over 140 different enemies to slaughter, from fluffy animals to gods.
Over 170 different items of equipment, and 150 different usable skills, allowing for lots of character customization.
Inspired by 16-bit era RPGs, minus the annoying features like random battles or save points.
Contains lots of video game references, immature humor, and anime boobs.
A mix of orchestral and electronic background music by HalcyonicFalconX. Full Soundtrack included!
25 hours of gameplay, plus Newgame+, survival and boss rush modes.
Suitable for both casual and hardcore RPG players.

422913.overview: The Enigmata galaxy is in peril once again, you and Neko are the only ones who can solve this crisis.

422917.overview:
The weather was fine, and everyone decided it was a great day to be outside. Elephant dressed up in his finest bowler cap. But while walking through the meadow, that big bully Wolly decided he like Elephant's hat better than his! Wolly took the hat from Elephant, cackling menacingly as he ran away! The thief! But Elephant knew he had to get his hat back, and would stop at nothing to get it!

Elephant Quest is a side-scrolling action role-playing game wherein the Elephant explores various environments to find the keys needed to reach Wolly and reclaim his hat. Elephant has a laser beam as a weapon, which the player aims by moving the cursor around Elephant. Upon leveling up, Elephant gains skill points, which the player can use to unlock upgrades to his attributes using a skill tree, which can then be assigned to sub-attributes which unlock various abilities, such as higher jumping or companion weapons. Throughout the game, there are multi-coloured elephants who will provide Elephant with side-quests such as collecting certain objects scattered throughout the game world.

When the game is completed, there is a New Game Plus mode wherein the player can start the game with the attributes from their previous save carried over.

422918.overview:
An apocalyptic action shooter set in the midst of an alien invasion. Most humans and animals have already been wiped off the planet, the eco system has been altered to suit the needs of the aliens, and the air has been made unbreathable for most earth creatures, including humans. Few humans are still alive. They are scattered, hiding in underground shelters and their fight for survival is a hopeless one. Desperate needs call for desperate measures, which could bring even more destruction.
Your mission: Survival.

422920.overview:
Elements is an escape room Flash game developed by Neutral, where you're locked in a room and the goal is to try to find a way to escape, but the way out is filled with Neutral's cunning puzzles, secrets, locks, and objects.

In order to escape the room, you have to explore every section of the room and examine objects by clicking on things. Since the cursor doesn't change even if it passes over something you can click on, it's important to try clicking on everything in each section of the room to find something that can be interacted with. Some items can be collected and will be added to your inventory when clicked on. Once an item is in the inventory, you can click on the magnifying glass symbol on its slot to view the item up close. Certain items can be further interacted with when viewing them up close, mainly by fusing other items to them. The room also contains plenty of puzzles that can be solved by observing details in certain other parts of the room and using those details to figure out the solutions to the puzzles. The game also has a save function you can use at any time to save your progress; you can pick up where you left off later by clicking the "Load" option at the title screen.

422922.overview: A chaotic shooter with RPG elements. Choose from 8 playable classes, train new skills, customize your weapons, develop your troops and survive, survive!

422925.overview: Epic Boss Fighter 2 is a shoot 'em up game in which you play as a hero that needs to save the world from huge beasts and machines that have come to conquer earth. It is the sequel to Epic Boss Fighter and has the same gameplay. The game adds new bosses, co-op mode, awards, new upgrades, normal and hard mode.

422928.overview: An atmospheric game with decent graphics that kick ass with puzzles.

422929.overview: Endless War 3 is a top down shooter flash game.

422931.overview:
Epic War is the first game of the Epic War series.

The game is set in a fantasy environment where a war against evil is going on. The goal is to destroy the enemy castle and defending your own castle from enemy encounters. To do so, the player has to summon creatures like hobbits, elves, dwarfs or angels. The enemy summons goblins, orcs, trolls or dragons. The stronger the kind of creature that's summoned, the more mana it costs. Once a creature is summoned, it walks to the enemy castle and fights every opponent on its way.

Every time the player has won a battle he gains experience. Experience is used to achieve or improve new skills or creatures. There is a total of fifteen battles in the game. Every battle can be played multiple times but needs to be unlocked beforehand. The last battle features a special enemy dragon.

422936.overview:
Delve into a strange cave with a seemingly endless supply of treasure, strategically choosing your battles to gather as much treasure as possible! Find rare artifacts and traverse the skill tree to become your choice of a mage, warrior, alchemist, or a mix of skills. Craft potions or enchant your equipment with ingredients, and discover secret areas! But be careful because the cave has oddly become quite dangerous lately with more explorers going missing every day…

The Enchanted Cave 2 is an RPG/roguelike with a heavy focus on risk vs reward. Strategically choosing your battles, building your character, enchanting your equipment and knowing when to escape the cave are crucial to succeed.
